paragraphs: Attention, everyone! Our school has a weekend event this Saturday. We plan something fun for all students.
In the morning, there is a sports event in the park. Everyone is welcome to join. You can bring something interesting to share with your friends.
In the afternoon, we explore the city museum. Someone will show us around. Is anyone interested? Please sign up before Friday.
Everything is ready for the event. If you have nothing to do this weekend, come and join us. It will be an enjoyable day for everyone.

paragraphs: This Sunday, I plan to do something special. I want to explore somewhere new in my city. It seems everyone is busy this weekend, so I go alone.
I take my notebook and my diary. I wonder what I will find. I walk along a quiet street and see a small park. There is nothing bored about it; the flowers are beautiful.
Suddenly, I hear someone laughing behind the trees. I look around but see nobody. Is anyone there? I call out, but no one answers.
At the end of the day, I go home and write everything in my diary. It is an enjoyable day. I learn that there is always something new to discover.

opts: There is always something new to discover.
It is better to stay home.

paragraphs: How do you spend your weekend? Many students say they have nothing to do. But a good weekend can be very meaningful.
First, plan something you enjoy. You can read something interesting or explore somewhere special. Everyone needs time to relax and have fun.
Second, spend time with your family. Someone in your family may need your help. Doing something together is enjoyable for everyone.
Do not say you are bored. There is always something to learn or someone to meet. If you have nothing planned, try something new. An enjoyable weekend makes you feel good for the whole week.

questions.q: What do many students say about their weekend?
What can you read for a meaningful weekend?
Who may need your help in the family?
What should you do if you have nothing planned?
What is the passage mainly about?
opts: How to spend a meaningful weekend.

sa.title: 阅读表达
sa.绑定: 复合不定代词 / 周末场景
paragraphs: A Fun Weekend Plan
This weekend, my family makes a plan together. Everyone is happy about it.
On Saturday morning, we go to the park. I want to bring something to eat, so my mother makes some sandwiches. We play games and everyone has fun.
On Sunday, we explore the museum. Someone shows us around, and we learn something interesting about history. Everything is well organized.
At the end of the weekend, we feel tired but happy. We learn that an enjoyable weekend is better when everyone does something together.

请把文中画线句子翻译成汉语（An enjoyable weekend is better when everyone does something together.）
questions.answer: 当大家在一起做些什么时，愉快的周末会更好。

writing.title: 书面表达
writing.prompt:
假如你是李华，请你用英语写一篇90词左右的短文，介绍你计划渡过的一个难忘的周末。内容包括：
1. 这个周末你计划做什么（用 plan/explore 等）；
2. 你会做什么有趣的事（用 something/anything/everyone 等复合不定代词）；
3. 你的期待是什么。
sample: This weekend, I plan to do something special. I want to explore a new park in my city.
Everyone in my family is happy about the plan. We will bring something to eat and play games together. I hope there is something interesting to see in the park.
I think an enjoyable weekend makes everyone feel good. Going out with my family is always fun. I am looking forward to this weekend!
writing.requirements: 1. 词数约 90 词；2. 用复合不定代词（something/anything/everyone 等）；3. 禁过去时；4. 语句通顺，意思连贯；5. 可适当发挥。
writing.绑定: 周末计划·复合不定代词
